title: rfair 0.1.0
text: assess_fair() resolves DOI, persistent identifier, URL, code repository, harvests metadata, scores FAIR metrics, returning fair_assessment object. Multiple metric sets, listed rfair_metric_versions(): current F-UJI data metrics (v0.8) default, several legacy domain-specific versions (0.2-0.8, plus social-science environmental variants), FRSM research-software metrics (0.7). Metadata harvesting registries (DataCite, Crossref, GitHub), landing-page embedded metadata (schema.org JSON-LD, Dublin Core, OpenGraph, Highwire), signposting typed links, content-negotiated XML (DataCite XML, MODS, EML, ISO 19139) RDF / JSON-LD, optional user-supplied metadata-service endpoints (OAI-PMH, OGC CSW, SPARQL, DCAT, schema.org, RO-Crate, CKAN). Software FAIR: pass GitHub repository metric_version = "0.7_software" score FRSM metrics repository signals (license, README, citation/codemeta, tests, CI, dependencies, coverage, releases, contributors). FRSM metrics operationalize FAIR Principles Research Software (FAIR4RS; Chue Hong et al. 2022, doi:10.15497/RDA00068). id_parse() recognizes DOI, Handle, ARK, URN, UUID, identifiers.org / w3id, compact prefix:accession identifiers.

title: rfair 0.1.0
text: fair_assessment object print(), summary(), .data.frame(), plot() methods. plot() draws category scorecard, per-metric breakdown, concentric FAIR "sunburst". as_fuji_json() exports assessment F-UJI FAIRResults JSON schema; as_rdf() exports W3C DQV quality measurements plus schema.org Rating (JSON-LD , rdflib, Turtle). bundled example assessment, fair_example, provided offline use.

title: rfair 0.1.0
text: license_reuse() judges whether license actually permits reuse, using (Re)usable Data Project taxonomy; reusabledata_rating() looks curated repository ratings. classify_access() flags controlled-access sensitive data (FAIR failures). identifier_hygiene() checks identifiers layered non-persistent forms. fair_tlc() reports FAIR-TLC (Traceable, Licensed, Connected) indicators. fair_principles() principle_definition() provide canonical FAIR principle definitions; fair4rs_principles() provides FAIR4RS principles research software, principle_definition() resolves FRSM software metrics FAIR4RS statement.
